mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: the temperature is 59 degrees with clear skies by the Verona Public Library and the moon is in its third quarter phase. Expect an overnight low of 52 degrees with no rain predicted.

October is now officially designated as Community Planning Month in Verona, recognizing the expertise and data-driven insights of our local planning department. Additionally, the city is promoting the tri-shaw Bike program at the Senior Center, which offers free 30-minute rides along the Military Ridge State Trail.

Today features the Dane County Farmers Market along with live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow you can visit the World Dairy Expo at the Alliant Energy Center or check out the annual apple cider pressing at the Farley Center Fall Festival.
On September 21, officers investigated a retail theft where an individual was identified via surveillance video for stealing candy from a business on East Verona Avenue and was subsequently cited.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Really Reese's. The restaurant is currently open, so stop by for a treat before they close at 10:30 PM.
